Systematically Break Down The Turtle Position With Gordon Ryan’s Signature Back Take Series - 2019 ADCC Double Champion Gordon Ryan Shows His Step-By-Step Method For Attacking The Turtle Position And Getting To The Bac

  • On this eight-volume series, learn the key fundamentals that Gordon exploits, how he sets traps for his opponents, his handfighting systems, and how he sinks his hooks in for back control

  • Gordon Ryan, and the entire team under Professor John Danaher, is known for a very step-by-step approach to grappling that is easy to understand and as precise as possible

Systematically Break Down The Turtle Position With Gordon Ryan’s Signature Back Take Series

2019 ADCC Double Champion Gordon Ryan Shows His Step-By-Step Method For Attacking The Turtle Position And Getting To The Back

Hammerlock from Cross Body Ride by Gordon Ryan:

What Will You Learn?

Systematically attack the turtle position with the best no-gi grappler on Earth, as Gordon Ryan shows the back taking system that he has mastered to win the ADCC Absolute Champion. On this eight-volume series, learn the key fundamentals that Gordon exploits, how he sets traps for his opponents, his handfighting systems, and how he sinks his hooks in for back control. Included with his technical instructions is live footage of Gordon sparring with these moves, so you can see them in action (and hear from Gordon himself as he analyzes the footage).

Gordon is the most successful no gi grappler in the game today, with a dominant double gold performance at the last ADCC cementing his legacy as number one. Gordon has become notorious for getting to his opponents backs and sinking in fight ending strangles, even against elite competition. In fact, in his eight wins at ADCC, he won five with a strangle from the back! Now is your chance to learn how Gordon effectively and methodically breaks down an opponent’s turtle and gets to his signature back control position.

Gordon Ryan, and the entire team under Professor John Danaher, is known for a very step-by-step approach to grappling that is easy to understand and as precise as possible. With these instructions, Gordon will explain key positions and concepts, like the cross body ride and diagonal control that is one of the hidden keys to his success. Know all the attacks and counters to your opponents options with these insights from one of the most well-reviewed instructors in the history of our website.

Get the important strategy and execution from the mind of Gordon himself as he rolls with grappler after grappler using this turtle system, then breaks down that footage to explain what he was doing and why he was doing it. Learn straight from the man himself how he is slowly, patiently, and technically increasing his control all the time by creating dilemmas and knocking his opponent to unathletic positions.

Study important sub-systems, tools, and concepts like the cross body ride, crucifix, reverse tight waist, and diagonal control. With key insights into what is fundamentally important to every position, Gordon explains how to move the right ways for the best results (regardless of size, strength, flexibility, or age). Never lose a back take with a dumb mistake again with these tips for getting to the back by breaking down the turtle.

With 8 huge volumes and hours of content, this series is an entire overview of one of grappling’s most common and important positions, the turtle position. Learn how the best back taker in no-gi is making it seem so easy by understanding his technique (including these killer hand fighting sequences to tie your opponents hands up). Find your way to the best position in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, the back, where you can finish fights safely by having a systematic way to attack the turtle position and sink your hooks in the right way.

This is your chance to learn from 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon Ryan as he shares all his secrets around escaping turtle and front headlocks 

  • Gordon is one of the most detailed and thorough teachers in grappling, with incredible systematic attention to detail.
  • Use peak outs, 4 points, sitting to half guard, and more to get away from front headlocks.
  • Roll to guard and escape from turtle with Gordon’s tips for staying safe and preventing hooks so you can get away from their control while still staying safe from submission threats.
  • These are the same systems that Gordon uses to build his defensive skills as a foundation for his entire game.
  • Watch as Gordon rolls in the gym from these same positions and then breaks down the footage to explain the techniques in action.                                                                                                                              


Build Your Game On A Strong Foundation Of Escapes With These Systems For Escaping Turtle Position And Front Headlocks With ADCC Champion & No-Gi Grappling Superstar Gordon “The King” Ryan

Checkout Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Learn all of the most effective systematic ways to escape from the turtle position and the front headlocks from the best no-gi grappler on Earth, Gordon “The King” Ryan. With hours of content on how you can clear hooks, prevent strangles, stop opponents who are getting behind you, and more on this 8-volume set.

Gordon Ryan is one of the best no-gi grapplers in history, and is still building his legacy with a path of submission success. With 3 ADCC World Championships & an IBJJF World No-Gi Championship, most focus on Gordon’s offense but he believes the true way to build your foundation is improvement on the ability to defend and escape. Now you can see how he approaches this important skill from these common no-gi positions.

Use shoulder rolls, stand ups, 4 point positions, and more to get out from turtle, as Gordon teaches you how to stay safe in what could be a dangerous position as you expose your back. Instead, see all the ways you can use these escapes to start setting up submission threats as you move back to guard and start launching your offense.

Work out of front headlocks with the confidence to not give up your neck or give up your back with Gordon’s advice. Use peek outs, guard pulls, rolls, and more as he explains how to defend yourself in this common problematic position without letting them attack with guillotines, darces, and more.

products.body:
Gordon Ryan teaches every detail behind his signature submission system, including the rear naked strangle that he has used to submit some of the best on Earth.

  • Watch Gordon break down gym footage to talk you through the techniques and system in real-time.
  • Learn the back attack system developed together by Gordon and his coach, Professor John Danaher, to create Gordon’s one-of-a-kind combos of strangles, arm locks, triangles, and more.
  • Gordon is fresh off of ADCC 2019, where he won double gold and strangled five elite black belts with these exact details.
  • Gordon Ryan has used this system nearly exclusively the last few years, including dozens of submission wins as a black belt.
  • Know More. Win More.



Learn The Complete Submission System That Has Made Gordon Ryan The Most Feared Back Attacker Ever

3-Time ADCC Gold Medalist Gordon Ryan Teaches Every Detail Behind His Signature Submission Back Attacks - Including The Rear Naked Strangle He Has Mastered


Check Out a Free Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Gordon Ryan is standing on top of the no-gi grappling world, and he has done it with a relentless technical game with one crown jewel - the most effective back attack system ever. Now is your chance, over eight packed volumes, to learn all of the techniques and combinations that make up this groundbreaking submission system. Get all the major concepts and subtle details, including a real-time video breakdown of Gordon explaining his system in action at the gym.

Gordon’s back control has become his signature, and he has shown the rare ability to consistently finish fights there, even against really elite black belts. This is because of the strangling techniques that his coach, John Danaher, developed and Gordon has evolved with. Instead of being a carbon copy of his coach’s system, Gordon takes those principles and problems and finds his own unique hand fighting combinations that get him to strangles, arm locks, triangles, and more.

Go through every possibility as Gordon Ryan teaches you his entire system for back attacking, including finishing with the strangle and troubleshooting against escaping opponents. Gordon teaches the basic concepts, how things change depending on the side, and how to hand fight (and elbow fight) for dominant grips. These 8 volumes contain one of the most complete and effective modern submission games in no-gi grappling, and this is your chance to learn from “The King” himself.

In addition to seeing Gordon explain every technique and combination, see the system in action as Gordon does positional sparring and then breaks down the footage for you. Now you can see not just what Gordon is doing, but hear why he is doing it and what you can learn from the analytical mind of Gordon Ryan. Don’t just learn how to attack, see what is the best move for that moment and how to stay one step ahead with this live demonstration of the system.
